Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-safecloak/-/issues/10 (opened by @DonnieBLT on 2026-06-14).

**Discussion summary**

- The homepage has a `curl -fsSL /install.sh | bash` command for Linux/macOS, which builds from source now that GitLab CI artifacts are gone. There are no prebuilt macOS or Windows downloads, and no forge release workflow for them.
events.title: blt-safecloak: create a build for mac and windows and add them to the download area featured on the homepage
